name: Watchers

source.note: Entered from published reviews and guides to Ravenloft: The Horrors Within (and Van Richten's Guide to Ravenloft, which it revises); compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: Ravenloft Dark Gift. Unseen watchers lend you Beast Sense, Speak with Animals and sharp eyes; a natural 1 lets them unnerve you.

benefits.name: Watching Eyes
benefits.summary: Beast Sense and Speak with Animals always prepared, each free once per Long Rest.
benefits.text: You always have Beast Sense and Speak with Animals prepared, and you can cast each once without a spell slot, regaining those uses on a Long Rest. Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for them (choose when you take the gift).

benefits.name: Many Eyes
benefits.summary: Add 1d4 to the checks of your Search action.
benefits.text: When you make an ability check as part of the Search action, you add 1d4 to it.

drawback.name: Drawback
drawback.summary: Disadvantage on saves against Scrying; on a natural 1, a Wisdom save (DC 13 + PB) or Disadvantage on D20 Tests for 1 minute (repeat the save each turn).
drawback.text: You have Disadvantage on saving throws against the Scrying spell. Whenever you roll a 1 on the d20 of a D20 Test, you make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 13 plus your Proficiency Bonus); on a failure the watchers' attention presses on you: you have Disadvantage on D20 Tests for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of your turns and ending the effect on a success.
